notes: Note 1: Total Crime Against Scheduled Castes includes: Murder, Rape, Kidnapping and Abduction, Dacoity, Robbery, Arson, Hurt, Protection of Civil Rights Act, SC/ST (Prevention of atrocities) Act and Other Crimes Committed Against Scheduled Castes
